capture_source: Derived from a live RFC_READ_TABLE(DD03L, ROWCOUNT=2000) response on the dev system (A4H, unicode) whose compressed DATA table spans multiple GW frames. The real joined response was re-split exactly on a 0x0305 record boundary into two GW frames, so the first frame ends cleanly between two fixed-width 0x0305 records with no 0xFFFF terminator. GW headers rebuilt: byte0=0x06, payload length at offset 56, continuation flag at offset 60 (0 on part1, 1 on part2), offset 17 = -1/500. Server->client only; no credentials.
evidence: Reproduces issue #44: a compressed TABLE whose GW chunk ends on a 0x0305 record boundary. tlv_stream_status(part1 body) must be 'truncated' (parser in sync, more follows) so _join_response_frames reads part2; the joined body re-forms the original (53513 bytes) and the DATA table decompresses to 2048000 bytes. Before the fix part1 classified as 'not_tlv' and the reader stopped, truncating the compressed stream.
